title: Family Around Autumn Campfire at Park, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A multi-generational family gathers around a small, smoking campfire at an outdoor park or campsite. On the left, three women and girls playfully laugh and embrace, dressed in cropped capri pants, sweaters, and classic mid-century hairstyles. On the right, a man wearing glasses and a bomber jacket stands alongside two young boys dressed in casual jackets. A wooden picnic table and bare trees in the background suggest a cool autumn or early spring afternoon of family recreation.
